messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "salamander", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The drawing shows a single stout, low-slung quadruped in three-quarter side view facing right, standing on four short thick legs with a long thick tapering tail extending behind. Its back, top of the head, sides, and top of the tail are covered in overlapping dark gray-brown rounded armor-like scales, while its throat, chest, belly, and underside of the tail are smooth pale cream-yellow. The head is broad and flat with a blunt snout, a wide straight mouth line, a small round nostril, and large prominent round eyes. Just behind the head on the neck are branched feathery external gills with central stalks and fine filaments.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat blunt-snouted amphibian-like head with wide mouth line and pale lower jaw", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "large round protruding eyes with dark pupils and light irises", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head, one fully visible on the right side and one partially visible on the far side"}, {"looks_like": "branched stalks with dense fine feather-like filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "on the neck just behind the head, three on the visible right side and two visible on the top of the far left side"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded dark gray-brown armor-like scales", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the top of the head, the entire back and sides, and the upper surface of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "bulky rounded torso with smooth pale cream-yellow underside", "part": "torso", "where": "in the middle of the body between the legs and below the scaled back"}, {"looks_like": "thick short smooth gray limbs sprawling outward", "part": "legs", "where": "two attached at the front chest and two at the rear belly"}, {"looks_like": "broad splayed feet with five short toes tipped with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of all four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long thick tapering tail, scaled above and smooth pale below", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear of the body backward"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
